llmResponse.agenda_changes: President Díaz-Slocum announced two agenda changes: (1) moving item 10.2 (Second Reading and Approval of Board Policy 1240 – Volunteer Assistance) to consent, and (2) moving item 10.6 (Approval of Addendum to Measure U Application for 2021-22 for Adelante Selby Spanish Immersion School) to consent. These items were moved to the consent agenda without objection.
llmResponse.consent_vote_words: Can I have a motion to move them including 10.2, 10.3, 10.4, 10.5 and 10.6. So moved second.
